title: Cheesy Bean Enchiladas
subtitle: with Sweetcorn and Yoghurt
description: Wrap Mexican beans and a charred corn salsa in soft tortillas, top with plenty of cheese and bake until golden – it's the whole enchilada!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C. Lightly grease a 2L (8 cup) ovenproof dish. Discard the husk and silks from the corn, then slice the kernels from the cob. Finely chop the tomatoes. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Coarsely grate half the cheese. Drain and rinse the beans.

Char corn: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the corn, garlic and 2 tsp Mexican spice blend (see Make it yours), stirring, for 3 mins or until charred. Add the tomato and cook, stirring, for 2 mins or until softened. Remove ¼ cup charred corn mixture from the pan and set aside.

Simmer bean filling: Add the beans, 1 tbs tomato paste and 125ml (½ cup) water to the pan and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins or until thickened. Remove the pan from the heat and stir through the yoghurt.

Assemble enchiladas: Top each tortilla with 2 tbs bean mixture and roll to enclose, then put in the prepared dish, seam side down. Spoon the remaining bean mixture around the enchiladas, scatter over the cheese and season with salt and pepper.
Bake and serve up: Bake the enchiladas for 10-12 mins until the cheese is golden and the enchiladas are warmed through. Scatter with the reserved charred corn mixture, divide among plates and enjoy!
Make it yours: Serving this to kids? Our Mexican spice blend has a mild chilli kick, so reduce the amount if you want to avoid the heat.
